bundle.shortDescription: Fast file search for Windows: search inside files, wildcard names, results treemap
bundle.longDescription: Spelunker searches the text inside files (literal, whole word, or regex), matches file names with wildcards or regex, and filters by size and date, across folders or whole drives, with no index. It previews each match, shows the results on a treemap colored by file type or age, and adds Search with Spelunker to the Explorer right-click menu.
